# Synthetic Longevity Fixtures

This directory is reserved for deterministic v133 local-data longevity fixtures.

## Allowed

- visibly synthetic identifiers, names, dates, categories, and amounts;
- deterministic populated vaults generated by `createSyntheticLongLivedVault()`;
- deliberately corrupted copies of synthetic portable packages;
- synthetic metadata records and references used to prove orphan handling;
- unsupported synthetic schema declarations;
- bounded synthetic capacity cases.

## Prohibited

Do not commit:

- real bank exports or transaction rows;
- real `.gringotts` packages or browser-local backups;
- real account, merchant, balance, category, budget, goal, plan, or recurring-cost data;
- real import profiles, receipts, close-history records, decision records, or workflow-review files;
- screenshots containing household data;
- credentials, tokens, identifiers, contact information, or provider metadata.

## Behavioral boundary

Fixtures may demonstrate detection, rejection, comparison, and reporting only. They must not authorize or implement automatic migration, repair, cleanup, compaction, rollback, overwrite, reset, deletion, or authoritative-vault replacement. Capacity bounds are test-harness limits only.
